name: OpenUV
tagline: Real-time and forecast UV index API for outdoor health apps
description: OpenUV provides real-time UV index, sun position, and multi-day UV forecast data by latitude/longitude. Commonly used for skin-health, outdoor recreation, and weather apps that need UV exposure guidance beyond basic weather conditions.

auth.details: API key via x-access-token header; self-serve signup at openuv.io

pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from ~$12/month with higher daily quotas

rate_limits: Free: 50 req/day; paid tiers increase daily quota (see pricing page)
use_cases: get current UV index for a lat/lng
fetch multi-day UV forecast for a location
estimate safe sun exposure time by skin type
get sunrise/sunset and sun position for outdoor planning
